title: Grammarly introduces generative AI tool GrammarlyGO

facts.fact: Grammarly announced GrammarlyGO, a generative AI content creation tool, with a beta release slated for April (2023).
facts.quote: Today, Grammarly announced GrammarlyGO, a generative AI product slated for beta release in April.

facts.fact: According to Grammarly, its product offerings boast 30 million daily users globally.
facts.quote: GrammarlyGO will be made available across Grammarly’s product offerings, which boast 30 million daily users globally.

facts.fact: Users of Grammarly Free can try GrammarlyGO in select markets, while it is also available for Grammarly Premium, Grammarly Business, Grammarly for Education and Grammarly for Developers.
facts.quote: Users of Grammarly Free will be able to try the new product in select markets.

facts.fact: The article reports that ChatGPT has grown to upwards of 100 million users since its late-2022 launch.
facts.quote: has grown to upwards of 100 million users since then.
